<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection/><condition/><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>GOVERNA - deny autonomous P1 closure</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous /*null when async*/) {

    // hasRole ではなく getRoles を使う理由は下記
    var roles = gs.getUser().getRoles();
    var isAgent = roles.indexOf('x_1821654_governa.agent') > -1;

    // 括弧を明示する。&& は || より優先されるため、括弧が無いと
    // 「(P1 かつ 6 へ) または (7 へ)」＝ 全 incident のクローズ禁止になる
    var closing = (current.state.changesTo(6) || current.state.changesTo(7));

    if (isAgent && current.priority == 1 && closing) {
        gs.addErrorMessage(
            'GOVERNA-DENY CTL: autonomous closure of P1 incident requires human approval');
        current.setAbortAction(true);
    }

})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-17 00:09:48</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>ca34713ac3930750f9ef98bc0501315c</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>GOVERNA - deny autonomous P1 closure</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Governa" source="x_1821654_governa">7d7d1dddc31f4710f9ef98bc05013114</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Governa">7d7d1dddc31f4710f9ef98bc05013114</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_ca34713ac3930750f9ef98bc0501315c</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-17 00:09:48</sys_updated_on><template/><when>before</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=ca34713ac3930750f9ef98bc0501315c"/></record_update>
